offline_inference_desktop.what: ball-6 on 416 px window frames, onnxruntime-web WASM, 1 thread, preprocess + run + decode
offline_inference_desktop.caution: a desktop CPU is far faster than an iPhone; use only as a relative baseline for 'did a change make inference slower'

motion_gate.what: share of 15 fps frames on which the app's motion gate (threshold and hold read from source) opens, so the model runs; simulated on the saved clips, independent of the detector
motion_gate.reading: the model is sent most frames on these clips: plan for near-continuous inference, not for a mostly idle model
motion_gate.caution: scene-dependent (wind, people in the window); the phone camera's own noise may differ from decoded video

replay_buffer_estimate.what: DERIVED from source constants, not measured: frames kept for the 6 s replay
